# PrismJS 1.30.0

Vendored from the official `prismjs@1.30.0` npm package under the MIT license.

Includes the unmodified minified core, clike, C, C++, Python, and Bash components. The bundle enables manual tokenization and disables worker message handling.

The lab renders tokens as text nodes and spans, preserving the editable source. Theme colors and application-specific grammar extensions are maintained in the lab HTML. No CDN requests are required.
